storyboard.learning_objective: See that 3² + 4² = 5² by counting the unit squares built on each side of a right triangle.

beats.name: triangle
beats.description: Draw the right triangle and its side lengths
beats.caption: A right triangle with legs 3 and 4
beats.narration: Here is a right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5.

beats.name: square_a
beats.description: Square on leg a, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Leg 3: square of area 3² = 9
beats.narration: The square on the leg of length 3 holds 9 unit squares.

beats.name: square_b
beats.description: Square on leg b, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Leg 4: square of area 4² = 16
beats.narration: The square on the leg of length 4 holds 16 unit squares.

beats.name: square_c
beats.description: Square on the hypotenuse, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Hypotenuse 5: area 5² = 25
beats.narration: The square on the hypotenuse, of length 5, holds 25 unit squares.

beats.name: equation
beats.caption: The two smaller areas add up to the largest
beats.narration: Add the two smaller areas: 9 plus 16 is 25.

beats.name: hold
beats.caption: So 3² + 4² = 5²
beats.narration: So 3 squared plus 4 squared equals 5 squared.
